title: fix(spec)!: refuse a dashboard globalFilters entry keyed dateRange beside a declared dateRange
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9XkoBAMEDmazTVe2qJYMJPG)_
Fixes #29213

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` teaches `dateRange` as the reserved name of the built-in date range and no file under `skills/**` keys a `globalFilters` entry `dateRange`; every taught use stays true. `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx` gains one sentence naming the refusal.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：仪表盘声明了内置日期范围 `dateRange` 时，`globalFilters` 里再写一个键为 `dateRange` 的筛选器（按 `name`，无 `name` 时按 `field`）现在会被拒收，报错落在该条目上并点名保留字。
- 为什么改：以前这样写能保存，控制台和 lint 都让后写的定义覆盖内置日期范围，看板上日期选择器消失，所有绑定 `dateRange` 的组件被另一个字段过滤，只有浏览器控制台一条警告。
- 风险与回滚：收紧契约，原本能通过的这类仪表盘会被拒；仓库内实测 0 个仪表盘这样写。回滚即还原本 PR 的两个提交。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/ui/duplicate-global-filter-names.ts`（新谓词与报错文案）、`packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts`（挂在仪表盘对象上的 refine）、`packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`（+5 个站点）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/dashboard-global-filter-reserved-date-range.test.ts`，预期 11 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/ui/duplicate-global-filter-names.ts` gains `reservedDateRangeGlobalFilters(dateRange, globalFilters)` beside `duplicateGlobalFilterNames`, sharing its `filterKeyOf` key derivation. I extended the module rather than adding a sibling because it is the same defect class: the built-in date range is a filter declared under the key `dateRange`, so an entry keyed `dateRange` is a second definition behind one key, exactly what the module's existing predicate refuses inside the array. The header no longer says `dateRange` "is not judged here".
- `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts` attaches `refuseReservedDateRangeGlobalFilters` to the dashboard OBJECT (`strictObject(...).superRefine(...)`), not to the array, because the verdict reads the sibling `dateRange`. One issue per entry, at `globalFilters[i].name` (or `.field` when unnamed), naming the reserved word and the built-in date range. The `GlobalFilterSchema.name` describe, the `globalFilters` describe and the `filterBindings` TSDoc now say the entry is refused, not only reserved.
- The refusal fires only when `dateRange` is declared (any non-null object, the test both resolvers use). On a dashboard with no `dateRange` the key is free and an entry keyed `dateRange` stays legal (see Acceptance notes).
- `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`: the build named five new sites (`ui/Dashboard` root and `manifest.dashboards.element` on the four installed-package projections); `measured.droppedRefinementSites` 988 → 993.
- ADR-0087 semantic entry `ui-dashboard-global-filter-reserved-date-range-refused` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`), changeset `.changeset/29213-dashboard-global-filter-reserved-date-range.md` (`minor`, `registered`), regenerated `content/docs/references/ui/dashboard.mdx`, one sentence in `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx`.
- Forced test edits: none. No existing test or fixture changed.

## Why

Measured on `main` @ `5a2bdf9c` before the change, with `dateRange: { field: 'name' | 'close_date' }` and `globalFilters: [{ name: 'dateRange', field: … }]`:

- Parse: `DashboardSchema.safeParse` answered `success: true` for the named entry, the unnamed `{ field: 'dateRange' }` entry and the undeclared case alike.
- Save door: `saveMetaItem` (the `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard` handler, stub-engine harness of `protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts`) answered `success: true` in `draft` (then `publishMetaItem` succeeded) and in `publish`; the row was stored `active`.
- Console board: `resolveDashboardFilterDefs` (`ui/packages/core`) returned ONE def, `{"name":"dateRange","field":"region","type":"text"}`, plus the console warning `duplicate filter name "dateRange" — the later definition wins`. The date-range control was gone and every `filterBindings.dateRange` bound `region`. Lint's `dashboardFilterDefs` keeps the later definition the same way, and `@objectstack/verify`'s window proof still proves the declared window the board no longer draws.

<details><summary>After the change (head commit)</summary>

- Save door, `draft` and `publish`: `INVALID_METADATA` 422, one issue at `globalFilters.0.name`, nothing stored.
- A row already stored with the pair still loads: `_diagnostics.valid: false`, one error at `globalFilters.0.name` carrying the refusal.
- The probes were scratch tests, deleted after the run (no permanent file).

</details>

## Tests

- New `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard-global-filter-reserved-date-range.test.ts` (11 cases): three controls (declared `dateRange` with another name; undeclared `dateRange` with an entry named `dateRange`; a named entry over a field called `dateRange`), the card reproduction located at `.name` with the message's first sentence, an empty `dateRange: {}`, an unnamed entry located at `.field`, two `dateRange` entries (one reserved issue each beside the duplicate-key issue), the refusal still answering when another key fails, and three predicate cases on stored-body shapes.
- Ablation (committed fix first, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, `dashboard.zod.ts` anchor `}).superRefine(refuseReservedDateRangeGlobalFilters));` → `}));`): 5 failed | 6 passed (11), the five refusal cases red and the controls and predicate cases green; restored blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The spec suite imports `./dashboard.zod` from source, so no dist was involved.

<details><summary>Package readings at head 6d7e2382</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 792 passed (792), Tests 23402 passed | 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 189 passed (189), Tests 7830 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: Test Files 301 passed | 4 skipped (305), Tests 22127 passed | 26 skipped.
- `ui/`: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/utils packages/plugin-dashboard`: Test Files 311 passed (311), Tests 3865 passed | 6 skipped.
- Dogfood (full battery, after a `turbo run build --filter=./packages/**` closure build, under the lock): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 391 passed | 3 skipped (394), Tests 3223 passed | 28 skipped (3251).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- A `globalFilters` entry keyed `dateRange` on a dashboard that does NOT declare `dateRange` stays accepted. It is meaningful there: the console draws its own control under that name, `filterBindings.dateRange` binds it, lint's `dashboard-filter-binding-unknown` accepts the key against it, and verify's window proof skips the dashboard. Refusing it unconditionally would widen the refusal past the card; it is an open question to the seat.
- Blast radius: zero authored dashboards key a global filter `dateRange` (`git grep` over `examples`, `apps`, `packages`, `ui` for `name:`/`field:` spelled `dateRange`: 5 hits, none a `globalFilters` entry; 115 files mention `globalFilters`).
- Mirror reach: the rule sits on the dashboard object, so a schema that spreads only `DashboardSchema.shape.globalFilters` keeps the duplicate-key rule and not this one. Every in-repo door parses `DashboardSchema` whole (the dropped-refinements build names the four manifest projections that carry it).
- The v18 stored-row listing (`packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.ts`) does not list this refusal; it is the sibling card #29212's surface and was not touched here.

## Verification

Head `6d7e2382`. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 106 families from 8 paths (331 changed lines); each ran after the last commit with its exit code recorded, and `--ran` answered: 106 derived, 106 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (exit 0).

<details><summary>Gate notes</summary>

- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: its pinned positive-control commit was absent from the shallow clone); after `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876` it answered exit 0, 48 cases.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date (after `gen:docs` regenerated `content/docs/references/ui/dashboard.mdx`).
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base 5a2bdf9c --event` (this body, offline): exit 0, level axis `no (narrowing)` / `narrowed`, no `patch` grading. `check-partof-closing-keyword.mjs` on this body: exit 0.
- Local-only `node scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs`: exit 1, "the workspace is not built", naming 35 `ui/` workspace packages with no `dist/` (only `./packages/**` was built here). It judges this container's dev-server precondition, not the spec dist, so it is reported and not acted on.
- CI families (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Build Core`, the UI jobs) are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI-owned and was not run locally.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
